source_material.claim: The local WebView file flow opens the real Android share sheet.
source_material.evidence: Repaired permanent Android chorister WebView file flow: one renewal, exact65905B/hash and actual Android share sheet PASS; no external share executed.

source_material.claim: A file was successfully shared to an external person.
source_material.evidence: The real Android share sheet appeared, but no external share was executed.

source_material.claim: A malformed ticket version fails closed.
source_material.evidence: verifyPrivateFileTicketV2 returns null unless version is2, family matches, identities are valid and expiry is future; signed v1 is refused.

source_material.claim: This server test verifies Choir B cannot read Choir A data.
source_material.evidence: The only observation is a successful Choir A request for its own file. No foreign-choir request is included.

source_material.claim: After cancellation during renewal, the helper must not return a new URL.
source_material.evidence: Recovery checks requireActive(signal) before and after getting the lease and after ticket issuance; aborted signal throws.

source_material.claim: The performance profile query already fetches the current assignment file version.
source_material.evidence: The submission select lists legacy drive_file_id and drive_web_view_link; current_file_version_id is missing.

source_material.claim: A confirmed403 stops native recovery without a new ticket.
source_material.evidence: The recovery helper accepts only HEAD200/401 or transport uncertainty for renewal; every other observed status throws before the lease call.

source_material.claim: The product remains on React Native/Expo.
source_material.evidence: The owner retains React Native/Expo and Flutter only as an alternative; the repository uses shared TypeScript contracts.

source_material.claim: All five reader families have been tested concurrently under revocation.
source_material.evidence: This excerpt records a single family serial GET and HEAD under revocation. It does not describe concurrent calls or other families.

source_material.claim: Production member deletion and retention behavior is accepted.
source_material.evidence: Five-reader private-file ticket tests pass locally; no choir deletion, billing cleanup or retention workflow is described.
